description: AI is great at planning trips and terrible at keeping them usable. Tralendr is the home for AI-planned trips. Ask ChatGPT to plan a trip, then save it to your free Tralendr account, where it becomes a visual day-by-day itinerary with every place on a map, shareable with one link, and ready on your phone while you travel. Plan anywhere, keep it in Tralendr. Free forever.
